interface Box<T> { next: T }
interface Loop { next: Loop }
type Forward = Box<Forward1>;
type Forward1 = Box<Forward2>;
type Forward2 = Box<Forward3>;
type Forward3 = Box<string>;
type Inner = Box<string>;
type Inner2 = Box<Inner>;
type Inner3 = Box<Inner2>;
type Backward = (Box<Inner3>);
type Eight = Box<Eight1>;
type Eight1 = Box<Eight2>;
type Eight2 = Box<Eight3>;
type Eight3 = Box<Eight4>;
type Eight4 = Box<Eight5>;
type Eight5 = Box<Eight6>;
type Eight6 = Box<Eight7>;
type Eight7 = Box<string>;
const forward: Forward = { next: { next: { next: { next: 'forward' } } } };
const backward: Backward = { next: { next: { next: { next: 'backward' } } } };
const eight: Eight = { next: { next: { next: { next: { next: { next: { next: { next: 'eight' } } } } } } } };
const first: Loop = forward;
const second: Loop = backward;
const third: Loop = eight;
console.log(first.next.next.next.next, second.next.next.next.next, third.next.next.next.next.next.next.next.next);

interface GenericBox<T> { next: T }
type GenericForward<T> = GenericBox<GenericMiddle<T>>;
type GenericMiddle<T> = GenericBox<GenericInner<T>>;
type GenericInner<T> = GenericBox<T>;
const generic: GenericForward<string> = { next: { next: { next: 'generic' } } };
const genericLoop: Loop = generic;
console.log(genericLoop.next.next.next);
